title: absorb_result
description: What one L2 absorb fan-out hands back to code (Implementation Decisions 9): the entries every reader returned, the synthesizer's sections or null when it returned none, and a failure for every chunk that came back short. workflows/absorb.js returns it into the Workflow run file and the conductor fan-out builds the same object from its launches. Code validates each entry against dossier_entry and the sections against dossier_sections before anything is merged, which is why they are only objects here.

chunk.description: the chunk that came back short; null for the synthesizer

missing.description: the obligation items no entry answered
